notes.title: Steam Scream Fest Participation + Patch Notes 1.0.2
notes.content:
Dear players,

Thank you for your incredible support and feedback. It's been a challenging month for us, but Happy Halloween! We hope you're enjoying a spooky season.

We’re excited to announce our participation in this year’s Steam Scream Fest! During the event, our game will be available at a 25% discount, so if you haven't picked it up yet, now’s the perfect time.

We're also rolling out a major patch with some important adjustments and additional language support, thanks to the fantastic team at Indiewords. We greatly appreciate their efforts.

Patch Notes v1.0.2

Localization:


 Simplified Chinese localization by Indiewords
 Turkish localization by Indiewords


Key Balance Adjustments:


 No More Insta-Death: Getting attacked by ghosts the first time will no longer result in an instant death. The second attack will be fatal, which should help reduce frustration from unexpected deaths.
 Quest Navigation Improvements: Red markers have been added to the map to assist with navigation, making it easier to find your way.


Other Minor Adjustments:


 Minor bug fixes and UI enhancements
 In-game instructions on how to access the legacy version


Thank you for your continued support! Feel free to reach out and leave feedback on our social media.

Best regards,
Hige Studio

notes.title: Hotfix v1.0.1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Dear Players,

Thank you for your continued support and feedback! To enhance the game's experience, we’re making the following adjustments:

1. Removed ghost colliders: Accidental collisions with ghosts will now be less punishing than before.
2. Candle gathering adjustment: Candles for the ritual are now located in one area, making the quest easier and reducing penalties for failure.
3. Revamped Ghost Jul's behavior: After stealing the money, you can now follow Jul to discover where he hides it.
4. Bug fixes related to culling: Resolved issues like suddenly dropping off the map and certain items being unpickable.
5. Limited music to active food stalls: This will help players identify which food stall is active and where it’s located.
6. Visual adjustments/fixes: Corrected minor visual glitches.
7. Maze difficulty adjustment: Eased the difficulty by widening the range where the red ghost despawns.

What We're Working On for the Next Update:

1. Reducing punishment from ghost attacks by preventing instant-death outcomes.
2. Further difficulty adjustments to the maze.
3. Additional minor bug fixes.

Feel free to reach out to us on Discord or social media with any more feedback!

Thank you.

Sincerely,
Hige Studio

notes.title: Acknowledgement and Hotfix
notes.content:
Dear Players,

Thank you for playing Nightmare Side: The Game. We understand that the Full Release version differs from the Early Access version. To accommodate this, we've kept the Early Access version available in the Legacy branch, accessible through the Betas menu in your Steam Client. It is with a heavy heart that we couldn't build the Full Release on top of the Early Access version due to technical and financial constraints, but we hope to resume work on it when the opportunity arises.

To address some major concerns regarding the Full Release version, we will implement the following changes:

1. Removing colliders from the ghosts: This will minimize accidental collisions with ghosts, which previously resulted in death.
2. Gathering candles in one area: This change will simplify the candle ritual quest.
3. Fixing bugs related to culling: This fix will address an issue where players could suddenly fall underground during exploration.
4. Ghost Jul's behavior: After Jul steals money, he will now run off in the direction where he hides it, helping players navigate more easily.
5. Limiting music to only active food stalls: This change will make it easier to identify and navigate to active food stall locations.

If you have any further concerns, feel free to leave a comment here or join our Discord server.

Thank you.

Sincerely,

Hige Studio

notes.title: Full Release v 1.0 Patch Note
notes.content:
Full Release is Finally Here!

It has been quite a journey for us. We want to acknowledge the support we've received along the way from players, our team who has been working tirelessly, Ardan Radio as our partner, and other collaborators who made this possible.

Early Access Version Preservation

In this Full Version, you'll essentially receive a brand new game. This new version may feel different from the Early Access version, and some players might prefer the Early Access version for its unique charm.

To preserve the Early Access experience, we have made it available in the Beta Branch. To access this, go to your Steam library, right-click on the game, click 'Properties', and from the 'Betas' tab, select 'Legacy' from the dropdown menu. We even plan to give this version a minor update if possible.

What's New in v1.0?

Here are some major changes in this Full Version:

1. New storyline & mystery
2. New objectives
3. New ghosts!
4. New ghost mechanics
5. Bigger map/location to explore
6. Localization feature for Indonesian and English
7. New achievements

Price Adjustment

The pricing we set for the Early Access was intentionally undervalued, as we wanted to appreciate the players who took the risk of playing the game in its experimental state.

To reflect the significant work done on the project, including tailor-made level design, accurate real-life location and character modeling, interviews, voice acting, IP-related assets, and gameplay, we need to adjust the pricing for the full release.

We intended to offer a substantial discount on the full release. However, due to Steam's policy, we cannot offer a discount until at least 30 days after the price change. We apologize for this inconvenience. We will put the game on sale once we have the opportunity and momentum to do so. Thank you for your understanding.

Future Updates:

1. Bug Fixing and Refining: Based on feedback, we will continue to make updates to fix any issues.
2. More Localization: In the near future, we will support Simplified Chinese, Turkish, and Ukrainian, with the help of Indiewords. More languages and announcements to come!
3. Free Side Story: We will be adding a side story based on the 'Apartment' scenario from the Early Access version. Side stories can be unlocked once you finish the Main Story, with more Side Stories to be added in the future.

Feedback and Discord

If you have any feedback, complaints, questions, suggestions, or anything else, feel free to reach out to us on our Discord community. The invite link can be accessed from the game Main Menu.

Thank you for your support.

Best regards,

Hige Studio

notes.title: REVAMP ANNOUNCEMENT
notes.content:
Hello! It's been a while!


First of all, we apologize for the lack of updates lately, but we're excited to share that we've been working on something big behind the scenes. Thank you for your support and feedback thus far. We've learned a lot throughout the Early Access phase, and we're thrilled to announce that we will soon release the game in its full version!

"Nightmare Side" is a locally established IP from Bandung, Indonesia. While we're proud of what we've achieved in replicating the experience from the radio show, as a game, we've faced numerous challenges. Apart from bugs and performance issues, we feel that the game lacks the depth to leave a lasting impression, and we acknowledge that we didn't provide enough context for our international audience.

Internally, we debated on how the full release version should be. The initial plan was just to polish the game or deliver the long-awaited 2nd chapter for free, which seemed like the most logical business decision.

However, we decided to go back to the drawing board, redo the entire research and investigation process (where we made a shocking revelation), and reevaluate the story and experience. We want to do this justice.

The result is a full REVAMP of the game, which will consist of approximately 70% new content:

1. A revamped storyline with more depth and mysteries
2. New ghosts with new mechanics
3. Fresh puzzles
4. A revamped quest system
5. Visual improvements
6. An even larger area to explore
7. New assets (audio, cutscenes, props, etc.)
8. A revamp of the episode format, now consisting of main and side stories
9. And many more enhancements

However, please note that your progress in the Early Access version of the game will be reset once we have the full release, as it will essentially be a whole new game. We hope this overhaul provides you with a better experience, and we're looking forward to hearing your thoughts once we have more to show you.

Cheers!

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.1.5
notes.content:
Dear Players,

We extend our heartfelt gratitude for your ongoing support and valuable feedback. Your dedication has been pivotal in shaping the game.

A Small Patch with Big Thanks:

In this update, we're delighted to introduce:

1. Steam Achievements:

Embark on new challenges and showcase your mastery with the introduction of Steam Achievements. Earn recognition for your in-game accomplishments!

2. Head-Bob Adjustment:

To enhance your gaming experience, we've adjusted the head-bob feature. Expect reduced motion sickness when using the flashlight, ensuring a smoother and more enjoyable gameplay.

3. Setting Synchronization:

Enjoy a seamless transition between in-game settings and the home screen. Your preferences will now synchronize, providing a more consistent and user-friendly experience.

4. GPU Optimization:

Continuing our commitment to optimization, this patch brings further improvements to reduce GPU usage. Experience a more optimized performance for smoother gameplay.

Looking Ahead:

As we roll out these enhancements, we're excited to share that we're beginning the development of new scenarios for the game. Stay tuned for more thrilling adventures in the near future.

Thank you for being part of this journey with us. Your support is invaluable.

Enjoy the updated gameplay, and keep those feedbacks coming!
